title: acer opulifolium subsp. neapolitanum
intro: Acer opulifolium subsp. neapolitanum, commonly known as the Purple Maple or Maple, is a deciduous shrub species native to Italy. This plant is believed to possess various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing oxidative stress, alleviating pain, and preventing infections. The therapeutic actions of Acer opulifolium subsp. neapolitanum include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and acting as a mild analgesic. Research suggests that the bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, tannins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
